sentences.text: Bob Dylan -LRB- -LSB- ˈdɪlən -RSB- born Robert Allen Zimmerman ; May 24 , 1941 -RRB- is an American poetic songwriter , singer , painter , writer , and Nobel prize laureate .	Nobel prize	Nobel prize
He has been influential in popular music and culture for more than five decades .
Much of his most celebrated work dates from the 1960s , when his songs chronicled social unrest .

Early songs such as `` Blowin ' in the Wind '' and `` The Times They Are a-Changin ' '' became anthems for the Civil Rights Movement and anti-war movement .	Civil Rights Movement	Civil Rights Movement	anti-war movement	Opposition to United States involvement in the Vietnam War

Leaving behind his initial base in the American folk music revival , his six-minute single `` Like a Rolling Stone '' , recorded in 1965 , enlarged the range of popular music .	American folk music revival	American folk music revival	Like a Rolling Stone	Like a Rolling Stone	folk	folk music
Dylan 's lyrics incorporate a wide range of political , social , philosophical , and literary influences .
They defied existing pop music conventions and appealed to the burgeoning counterculture .	counterculture	Counterculture of the 1960s

Initially inspired by the performances of Little Richard and the songwriting of Woody Guthrie , Robert Johnson , and Hank Williams , Dylan has amplified and personalized musical genres .	Little Richard	Little Richard	Woody Guthrie	Woody Guthrie	Robert Johnson	Robert Johnson	Hank Williams	Hank Williams	musical genres	Music genre

His recording career , spanning more than 50 years , has explored the traditions in American song -- from folk , blues , and country to gospel , rock and roll , and rockabilly to English , Scottish , and Irish folk music , embracing even jazz and the Great American Songbook .	blues	blues	rock	Rock music	country	Country music	gospel	gospel music	Great American Songbook	Great American Songbook	folk	folk music	rock and roll	rock and roll	rockabilly	rockabilly	English	Folk music of England	Scottish	Scottish folk music	Irish folk music	Folk music of Ireland	jazz	jazz
Dylan performs with guitar , keyboards , and harmonica .
Backed by a changing lineup of musicians , he has toured steadily since the late 1980s on what has been dubbed the Never Ending Tour .	Never Ending Tour	Never Ending Tour
His accomplishments as a recording artist and performer have been central to his career , but his songwriting is considered his greatest contribution .
Since 1994 , Dylan has published seven books of drawings and paintings , and his work has been exhibited in major art galleries .
As a musician , Dylan has sold more than 100 million records , making him one of the best-selling artists of all time .	best-selling artists of all time	List of best-selling music artists

He has also received numerous awards including eleven Grammy Awards , a Golden Globe Award , and an Academy Award .	numerous awards	List of awards received by Bob Dylan	Golden Globe Award	Golden Globe Award	Academy Award	Academy Award

Dylan has been inducted into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame , Minnesota Music Hall of Fame , Nashville Songwriters Hall of Fame , and Songwriters Hall of Fame .	Rock and Roll Hall of Fame	Rock and Roll Hall of Fame	Minnesota Music Hall of Fame	Minnesota Music Hall of Fame	Nashville Songwriters Hall of Fame	Nashville Songwriters Hall of Fame	Songwriters Hall of Fame	Songwriters Hall of Fame

The Pulitzer Prize jury in 2008 awarded him a special citation for `` his profound impact on popular music and American culture , marked by lyrical compositions of extraordinary poetic power . ''	Pulitzer Prize	Pulitzer Prize	special citation	Pulitzer Prize Special Citations and Awards
In May 2012 , Dylan received the Presidential Medal of Freedom from President Barack Obama .	Presidential Medal of Freedom	Presidential Medal of Freedom	President Barack Obama	Barack Obama
In 2016 , he was awarded the Nobel Prize in Literature `` for having created new poetic expressions within the great American song tradition '' .	Nobel Prize in Literature	Nobel Prize in Literature
